instruction: Open calculator.py on the Desktop and uncomment the line that prints 'Sorted array is:' so it actually prints when the script runs.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened calculator.py in Text Editor, correctly identified the missing insertion sort line, added arr[j+1]=arr[j], but introduced tabs/spaces indentation mismatch. Spent 40 turns trying to fix indentation errors without success.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open files from desktop, read Python code, use Text Editor for basic editing, open terminal, type and run commands, redirect output to files
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed due to inconsistent indentation (tabs vs spaces) when adding new code in Text Editor GUI. Repeated attempts to fix indentation all failed because the GUI editor inserted different whitespace than the original file.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to removing a comment character instead of adding a new code line, avoiding the indentation problem that caused failure
metadata.explanation: Task requires uncommenting line 17 in calculator.py (remove the # from '# print ("Sorted array is:")'. Evaluator reads the file and checks if the line containing 'Sorted array is:' is no longer commented out.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads calculator.py via env.controller.get_file() and searches for the line containing 'Sorted array is:', returning whether it starts with '#'
Metric correctly returns 1.0 when is_commented is False (line successfully uncommented) and 0.0 otherwise
Postconfig properly activates Text Editor and saves with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the file state is up to date
Full instruction coverage: the single requirement (uncomment the print line) is completely verified
Edge cases handled: file-not-found and line-not-found both return error dicts that the metric maps to 0.0
